name: Blank Slate
subtitle: Think alike. Score together.
shortDescription: Fill the blank, match your friends, and settle surprising answers together.
description: Blank Slate is a private-write word matching party game for friends. Join in one tap, write your slate privately, reveal everyone together, score exact matches, vote on close groups, and play to a target or fixed round count. Native offline resend, quiet hours, personal turn notifications, host correction, and strict TV redaction keep play fair.
reviewNotes: Use Continue as guest for the complete journey. Other players are simulated for review; no answer appears in another player or TV projection before reveal.
releaseNotes: Initial mobile release with private native slate entry, group scoring, merge votes, host fix-up and undo, offline replay, haptics, personal notifications, and custom prompt decks.
